name: Cable Upright Row
steps: Stand facing a low pulley with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar overhand about shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall with your core braced and arms hanging straight in front of your thighs.
Lead with your elbows to pull the bar straight up close to your torso until elbows near shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower the bar under control until your arms straighten.
tips: Keep your elbows at or below shoulder height and your wrists relaxed.
Avoid leaning backward or using a very narrow grip that pinches your shoulders.
